title: Breaking the Assistant Mold: Modeling Behavioral Variation in LLM Based Procedural Character Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting generated characters with normative moral statements from the Social Chemistry dataset and measuring the distribution of their multiple-choice agreement or disagreement responses.

Asking generated characters conversational questions from the ConvAI2 dataset and using an auxiliary LLM to classify their open-ended replies into behavioral categories such as compliance, refusal, or deflection.
